registry.emptyBody: The apps you register will appear here: installed programs, web addresses and protocols.

confirm.deleteAppBody: The app leaves the registry. The program or website is not touched.
confirm.deleteCategoryBody: The apps in this category stay in the registry, without a category.
confirm.changedBody: The program is no longer the one you confirmed last time. If you updated it yourself, launch it and confirm the new version.

lock.title: The registry is locked
lock.bodyHello: Unlock with Windows Hello or with your PIN.
lock.retryIn_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
lock.retryIn_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.

security.title: Security
security.offBody: Set a PIN: the app will lock every time it starts, after a period of inactivity and when you lock Windows.
security.onBody: The app locks every time it starts, after the chosen period of inactivity and when you lock Windows. Ctrl+L locks it right away. The lock stops people using this computer, not programs already running.
security.helloHint: Your PIN always remains available as an alternative.
security.helloPrompt: Confirm your identity to use Windows Hello with {{name}}.

pin.disableBody: Enter your current PIN. Windows Hello is turned off together with the lock; the registry stays as it is.
pin.hint: 6 to 16 digits. All-identical digits and sequences such as 123456 are not allowed.
pin.mismatch: The two new PINs do not match.

errors.DB_WRONG_KEY: The key does not open the database, or the file is damaged.
errors.DB_CIPHER_UNAVAILABLE: Database encryption is not active: the registry is not opened.
errors.DB_SCHEMA_TOO_NEW: The registry was created by a newer version of the app.
errors.DB_KEY_MISSING: The registry exists, but its key is not in the Credential Manager. Your data has not been touched.
errors.DB_KEY_INVALID: The stored registry key is not valid.
errors.NAME_INVALID: The name must be 1 to 80 characters long, without control characters.
errors.NAME_DUPLICATE: An item with this name already exists.
errors.URL_INVALID: The address is not valid. Do not put a user name or password in the address.
errors.SCHEME_NOT_ALLOWED: This type of address is not allowed.
errors.EXECUTABLE_MISSING: The program is no longer at the registered path.
errors.HASH_MISMATCH: The program has changed since it was last confirmed.
errors.TAG_INVALID: Each tag can be up to 32 characters, with at most 12 tags.
errors.PIN_INVALID: The PIN must have 6 to 16 digits, with no letters or spaces.
errors.PIN_TOO_SIMPLE: The PIN is too easy to guess: avoid all-identical digits and sequences such as 123456.
errors.PIN_NOT_SET: The lock is not set up: set a PIN first.
errors.PIN_THROTTLED: Too many attempts: wait before trying again.
errors.PIN_HASH_FAILED: The PIN could not be checked. Try again; if it happens again, restart the app.
errors.IDLE_INVALID: The inactivity time must be between 1 and 240 minutes.
errors.KEYSTORE_UNAVAILABLE: The Windows Credential Manager is not responding.
errors.APP_DATA_UNAVAILABLE: The app data folder is not accessible.
errors.DIALOG_FAILED: The file picker did not open.
errors.LAUNCH_FAILED: Windows did not launch the app.
errors.LOCKED: The app is locked. Unlock it to continue.
errors.NOT_FOREGROUND: Bring the window to the front and try again.
errors.HELLO_NOT_ENABLED: Windows Hello is not turned on for this app. Use your PIN.
errors.HELLO_NO_DEVICE: No Windows Hello device is available on this computer.
errors.HELLO_NOT_CONFIGURED: Windows Hello is not set up for your account. Set it up in Windows Settings.
errors.HELLO_DISABLED_BY_POLICY: Windows Hello is turned off by this computer's policies.
errors.HELLO_BUSY: The Windows Hello device is busy. Try again shortly.
errors.HELLO_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED: Too many Windows Hello attempts. Use your PIN.
errors.HELLO_FAILED: Windows Hello did not respond. Use your PIN.
